title: 栽下以后
standfirst: 树列、园路、玻璃与红筐：草木进入人的安排，也保留各自伸展的方向。
standfirstEn: Rows of trees, garden paths, glass and red baskets: plants enter human arrangements while keeping their own directions of growth.
introduction: 淡色的步道绕入深绿，一排树干从紫色的花间立起。随后，树列把道路收窄，层叠的树冠靠近瓦檐，玻璃穹顶与红色塑料筐为植物划出大小不同的边界。
这十二幅照片从可以走入的空间，移向叶面和花穗。枝叶与人的安排并行，也让那些安排变得不一样：影子越过路面，花穗偏向一侧，枝上的扇形与地面的扇形在两幅照片中相接。观看由远及近，最后低下头。
introductionEn: A pale path curves into deep green; rows of trunks rise from violet flowers. Trees narrow a road, layered crowns meet tiled eaves, and a glass dome and red plastic baskets mark boundaries of different sizes around plants.

These twelve photographs move from spaces one can enter towards leaf surfaces and feathery plumes. Foliage follows human arrangements while changing their appearance: shadows cross a road, plumes lean to one side, and fan-shaped leaves above meet fan-shaped leaves on the ground across two photographs. The view moves closer and finally looks down.

chapters.title: 成行
chapters.text: 树干沿着步道和车道排列，枝条在上方交错。路面的方向清楚可见，树影却从旁边横过来，与经过的人重叠。
chapters.textEn: Trunks line a walkway and a road, while branches cross overhead. The direction of the pavement is clear; shadows arrive from the side and overlap the people passing through.

chapters.title: 边缘
chapters.text: 树冠与瓦檐相接，绿墙靠近玻璃网格，几株花装在草地上的红筐里。枝叶的尺寸改变了，容纳它们的东西也随之显出来。
chapters.textEn: A tree crown meets tiled eaves, a planted wall approaches a grid of glass, and flowering plants stand in red baskets on the grass. As the scale of the foliage changes, its containers come into view.

chapters.title: 叶面
chapters.text: 水珠停在圆叶上，细长的花穗向一侧展开。目光再沿一根斜枝向上，最后回到铺满黄叶的地面。近处的草木，逐渐替代远处的道路和框架。
chapters.textEn: Drops rest on round leaves; slender plumes spread to one side. The view follows a diagonal branch upwards, then returns to a ground covered in yellow leaves. Nearby plants gradually take the place of distant roads and frames.
